Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing public funding of local office campaigns.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public funding of campaigns for local offices;amending RCW 42.17.128; and adding a new section to chapter 42.17 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.17.128 and 1993 c 2 s 24 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Public funds, whether derived through taxes, fees, penalties, orany other sources, shall not be used to finance political campaigns forstate ((or local)) office.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A county, city, town, or district that establishes a program topublicly finance local political campaigns may only use funds derivedfrom local sources to fund the program.
